evaluation: Ten completed calendar years 2016-2025; 2026 separately. Prior 2011 data warm up features and 2012-2015 samples initialize training.
target: USD/KRW mean of next 12 available daily observations divided by last eligible FX close minus one, times 100. Different source and origin schedule from TimesX; earlier scores are not directly comparable.
schedule: Every 12th FX observation from the first date in 2012 onward, no target-window overlap. Origin at 00:00 Korea time on that observation date. Training label eligible only after its last bar timestamp plus 48 hours. Complete 2016-2025 assessment requires the target end date within 2025; boundary crossing windows separately disclosed, not assigned to the ten-year total.
features: FX own 1/5/20-observation return and 20-return volatility plus month sine/cosine. M adds same four features for each of four stock indices. Use bars timestamp+48h <= cutoff, minimum 21 bars and maximum 14-day stale. No news, investor flow or additional exchange-rate covariates.
arms: D0 zero change naive; D1 FX history and month; DM D1 plus four equity indices
model: Expanding-history ridge lambda=1, train-only standardization, at least 40 training samples; no tuning
metrics: Primary D1-DM paired MAE, 95% descriptive block-bootstrap interval (5000 draws, length 3, seed 20261026); per-year, 2016-2020 versus 2021-2025, and 2026 separately. Also compare against D0.
news_gap: Existing TimesX news starts 2023. No fabricated news or zero-filled missing years. Full four-arm news experiment over 10 years remains unexecuted.
limits: Retrospective retrieved prices, not historically verified vintages
48h is an assumption, not a release-time audit
2021 split is user-selected, not proof of an AI effect
Market missingness or stale windows are disclosed
Prior hypotheses and recent outcomes already explored; not preregistered independent confirmation
